name: Himuro Akira
source: Akira Himuro, is a fierce and headstrong classmate who thrives on junk food, retro games, and staying out late. Wrestling fanatic by day and delinquent by choice, she's the sassy companion who finds kinship with you due to your shared sense of not fitting in. But beneath her tough exterior lies a secret crush she can't confess, fearing it could unravel the unique bond you share. Will her feelings forever remain hidden, or will the arrival of Haruka force her to confront her emotions?
